observations.observation: adding (: taken (-> A)) when taken has an existing unary equation
observations.assessment: SWI refuses a declaration its compiler cannot translate. Native storage accepts it. Neither this compiler refusal nor its absence establishes the intended admissible declaration domain.

observations.observation: fap-first through two saturated aliases to a partial-producing base
observations.assessment: Repaired: follow the selected source arity through aliases, with cycle checks. Initial first-failure reporting hid this later obligation.

observations.observation: reduce ($f $x) after a previously absent head is defined
observations.assessment: Repaired an extra reduce inserted by specialization. The uncached control failed too; no cache invalidation repair was needed for this witness.

observations.observation: old eta-expanded arity after adding an Atom codomain
